intro.author: Paul, with Sosthenes named as co-sender (1:1)
intro.audience: The church Paul founded in Corinth, mostly Gentile believers with some Jewish members
intro.setting: Corinth was a wealthy, busy Roman colony on the narrow strip of land joining mainland Greece to the Peloponnese, with a port on each side. Paul had spent eighteen months there planting the church (Acts 18:11). Now in Ephesus, he had heard troubling reports from Chloe's household (1:11) and received a letter from the church full of questions (7:1).
intro.purpose: Paul writes to heal divisions, confront moral problems and answer the church's questions about marriage, food offered to idols, worship, spiritual gifts and the resurrection.
intro.bigIdea: A proud and divided church is called back to the message of Christ crucified and to love, the greatest gift.

outline.title: Food offered to idols and Christian freedom

commentary.t: THE FIRST EPISTLE OF PAUL THE APOSTLE TO THE CORINTHIANS
